definitions: To do things that are new or unfamiliar to you, or that make you feel nervous but can lead to personal growth.
To intentionally put oneself in situations that are beyond one's usual or preferred activities, often to achieve a goal or experience something new.
examples: She decided to step out of her comfort zone and try skydiving.
To learn a new skill, you often have to step out of your comfort zone.
He encouraged his team to step out of their comfort zone and propose innovative ideas.
lemma: step out of your comfort zone
source: step out of your comfort zone
